items.title: Prediction: Synopsys Will Hit $650 on This Date
items.summary: Synopsys posted 42% revenue growth, raised guidance, and closed a landmark $35 billion acquisition, yet the stock sits down 34% over the past year. Something has to give, and the timeline for a potential breakout is narrowing.
